preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N >= 4 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer N where 4 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == N for N, a in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case's second line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(a_i) <= 10**9 for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]] for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the sequence satisfies |a_i| ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == N for N, b in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(b_i) <= 10**9 for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()] for b_i in b)
postconditions.description: Each element b_i in the output sequence satisfies |b_i| ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(any(b_i != a_i for i in range(N)) or all(b_i == a_i for i in range(N)) for N, a, b in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: The output sequence b differs from the input sequence a in at most one position.

postconditions.expression: all(any((b[i] - b[i-1] == b[i+1] - b[i] for i in range(1, N-1)) and (b[0] - b[1] == b[1] - b[2] if N > 2 else True) and (b[N-1] - b[N-2] == b[N-2] - b[N-3] if N > 2 else True) for N, b in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: The output sequence b is an arithmetic sequence (i.e., the difference between consecutive elements is constant).
